mechanism: Both agents reduce blood pressure through different mechanisms (thiazide diuretic vs. ARB), and chlorthalidone may cause electrolyte depletion (potassium, sodium) while irbesartan increases potassium retention, creating opposing effects on serum potassium levels.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum electrolytes (particularly potassium and sodium), and renal function regularly; adjust doses as needed to avoid hypotension, hyperkalemia, or hypokalemia.
